promises.quote: the Department for Transport are currently reviewing the Scheme , analysing ideas put forward during the Consultation. Should the Ministers decide to amend the scheme, feasible options will be subject to further consultation. Due to legal processes and Government priorities, the earliest the changes could be brought into scope would be 2015.
promises.summary: Review the VIC scheme and consider amendments by 2015
